## Merge checklist

- [ ] All fully resolved issues use `Closes #...`; incomplete work uses `Refs #...`
- [ ] PR scope and verification evidence match the current commit
- [ ] CI status checked for the exact PR head commit
- [ ] Human owner has approved merging
